scope: Installed Git 2.43 fetch-only compatibility and absence of the newer local-link repack path; not a performed fetch or full repository validation.

observed_execution_receipts.observed: Installed versions, selected safe config values, and rev-parse format/worktree checks.
Effective exec paths and equal read-only ref listings.
Byte hashes of installed Git/helper binaries and helper git --version.

both_versions_ref_listing.time_scope: Observed snapshot during this review, not a claim about future moving refs.

conditional_recommendation.required_operational_boundary: Keep existing authentication, remote, refspec and partial-clone filter; add --no-auto-maintenance; retain complete-OID and promisor/ordinary partition-preserving maintenance. Do not use this as a general GC/repack replacement.

limitations: Absence of this specific new local repack path is source-proven; reduction of actual new pack bytes has not been tested.
No claim that Git 2.43 lacks delta-base caching or the general OI_DBCACHED enum.

The omitted 2024 path also protects local objects referenced only by fetched promisor objects against later garbage collection. Fetch-only use requires avoiding reachability-only GC or ordinary repacking that could discard such objects.
Format/extensions and refs were actually parsed by both binaries. Full object decoding, MIDX compatibility under all operations, fetching and all newer Git features were not exercised.
An unset extensions.partialclone does not establish absence of a partial clone; remote promisor/filter configuration was not read.
No new causal proof that every observed repeated pack arose from the diagnosed cache classification path.

sources.observed: No repack_local_links function or call. --promisor argument is already parsed; finish writes the marker for the received pack. End of main has no local-link repack step.
No is_not_in_promisor_pack_obj predicate from the later local-link-repacking change.
Exact release-tag navigation succeeded; these are not merely release-candidate sources.
